This sample is part of the "PPG
MULTISAMPLE 008 Dissonant Space Organ" sample pack. A short dissonant
chord with a sound that is similar to that or an organ. In the sample
pack there are 16 samples evenly spread across 5 octaves (C1 till C6).
The note in the sample name (C, E or G#) does not indicate the pitch of
the sound but the key on my keyboard. The sound was created on the PPG VSTi. After that normalising and fades where applied within Cubase SX.
